verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Terminal API that drives payments, refunds, and other shopper-terminal interactions using JSON messages with no libraries required. It works over a local network or the cloud, so a custom POS backend can send requests such as tip amounts to the terminal. Refunds and a test system are also documented. The old HN comment about a COM integration describes a past state and itself mentions JSON readers coming, so it does not concretely contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a current server-driven integration, and detail on the cloud (backend-to-terminal) request flow beyond a brief mention.
